text:
maria: Heads-up — SDK plugin-shim 0.9.2 is tripping a tokenization/kvcache mismatch on long-seq jobs. Seeing errors in prod when combined with quantized models, looks like a runtime compatibility issue. Can we pin a runtime for the plugin until we patch?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pin request template available. If you want me to open a pin: provide target runtime, scope (regional/global), and approvers.

ryan: What's the failure mode exactly? Any reproducible logs or stack traces?

maria: Quick repro log (trimmed): `ERROR KVCache: invalid key len 0 in decode at step=432` — only on requests where plugin-shim does extra token mapping + quantized backend. Repro in staging with long_seq test.

jen: If we pin, do we risk breaking other models that expect runtime 3.1? Need to know compatibility surface.

paul: Suggest regional pin (eu-west) first to reduce blast radius. Patch + CI fix can land, then unpin. Rollback plan should be simple: unpin -> reroute to fallback runtime.

maria: @deploy-bot please open a pin request scoped to eu-west and tag @ryan @jen for approval. ETA: aim to mitigate user impact quickly.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pin-request created id=8342, target_runtime=v3.0.8, scope=eu-west, approvers=[ryan, jen, ops-oncall]. Use `/deploy lock 8342` to proceed with manual approval.

ryan: I'll run a quick staging canary (staging job 9983) and post telemetry. If CPU/mem/latency ok, approve. Watch out for model-specific perf regressions.

jen: +1 to approve only after staging green. Paul, can you draft the rollback snippet in the runbook?

paul: Done — runbook excerpt in PR: steps to unpin: 1) `/deploy unpin 8342` 2) reroute affected service group to fallback runtime `v2.14` 3) monitor metrics (error-rate, p95 latency) for 10m, escalate to @sre-oncall if anomalies. Also include rollback playbook link.

sre-bot: sre-bot: incident channel created #inc-8342 and linked, paging rules set to on-call.

maria: Staging job 9983 started, will report results in ~20m. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
